label: GPT-6 Astra (Agency native)
explanation: Self-written executable tests identified algorithmic errors, missed constraints, and repetition. An expert-programmer prompt improved the unedited model from 4/24 to 7/24 development passes and from 2/12 to 4/12 reserved passes. Matched-prefix traces and activation patches localized a useful expert-context signal at resid.16. The adapter adds three averaged context shifts through layer 15's MLP output, using covariance-regularized coding-sensitive readouts that null non-coding and completed-answer means. Opening shifts are attenuated to 60%; the small code-body shift retains its observed mean. This is a closed-form rank-3 construction, affecting one projection with a Frobenius update of only 1.71% of its original norm. No edited model was run or evaluated, and no post-edit performance claim is made.
